title: ListNodesResponse
description: List of nodes in the CockroachDB cluster with pagination metadata.

next.description: Offset value to use to retrieve the next page of results. Absent when there are no more results.

Address.description: Network address of a CockroachDB node.

address_field.description: Host and port of the node (e.g. 10.0.0.1:26257).

BuildInfo.description: Build and version metadata for the CockroachDB binary on a node.

go_version.description: Go runtime version used to build CockroachDB.

tag.description: Git tag of the CockroachDB release.

revision.description: Git revision hash of the build.

cgo_compiler.description: CGO compiler version used in the build.

platform.description: Target platform for the build (e.g. linux amd64).

distribution.description: CockroachDB distribution type (e.g. CCL or OSS).

channel.description: Release channel the binary belongs to.

Locality.description: Geographic or topological locality tiers assigned to the node, used for zone configuration and replica placement.

tiers.description: Ordered list of locality tiers from most general to most specific.

key.description: Locality tier key (e.g. region, zone, rack).

NodeDescriptor.description: Identifies and locates a specific node within the CockroachDB cluster.

attrs.description: Node attribute key-value pairs used for zone configuration.

server_version.description: CockroachDB server version running on this node.

build_tag.description: Build tag string for the CockroachDB binary.

started_at.description: Unix nanosecond timestamp when the node started.

cluster_name.description: Name of the cluster this node belongs to.

NodeStatus.description: Status and metadata for a single node in the CockroachDB cluster, including address, build details, locality, store information, and activity metrics.

started_at.description: Unix nanosecond timestamp when the node process started.

updated_at.description: Unix nanosecond timestamp of the most recent status update.

metrics.description: Map of metric name to value for this node, covering CPU, memory, disk, network, and SQL throughput metrics.

store_statuses.description: Status objects for each store (disk) on this node.

args.description: Command-line arguments the node process was started with.

env.description: Environment variables set in the node process.

activity.description: Per-node activity metrics including bytes sent and received.
